name: User with expired session cannot access protected endpoints
fullName: ../.features-gen/e2e-tests/bdd/features/security-401-unauthorized.feature.spec.js › Authentication Boundary Protection › User with expired session cannot access protected endpoints

steps.name: Given a company user is signed in with a backend session
Then a valid session cookie "session" should be set
cookie "session" must be set (have: session, session_sig)
session_sig must accompany the session cookie (HMAC pair)
And the fresh session should be able to access "/users/me"
authenticated /users/me must return the user id
When the stored session cookie pair is invalidated
And I try to access the protected endpoint "/users/me" with my expired session
Then the response status should be 401
And the response should carry the unauthorized error envelope for "/users/me"
X-Request-ID response header must be set
And the rejection reason should map to messageKey "error.auth.invalid_token"
expected reason must be an error.auth.* dictionary key
